source.note: Same input as config-max-edges-default with maxEdges 2, a secure key only site configuration can set: FlowDB.addSingleLink throws 'Edge limit exceeded'.

error.name: Error
error.message:
Edge limit exceeded. 2 edges found, but the limit is 2.

Initialize mermaid with maxEdges set to a higher number to allow more edges.
You cannot set this config via configuration inside the diagram as it is a secure config.
You have to call mermaid.initialize.
